name: guest-house-management
description: Workspace root for the Guest House Manager monorepo (guesthouse-api + guesthouse-web). Exists only to give Agent Control Center a single lint/typecheck/test/build entrypoint — this package has no source of its own.

scripts.typecheck: npm run type-check --prefix guesthouse-web && cd guesthouse-api && mvnw.cmd compile
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix guesthouse-web && cd guesthouse-api && mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests
